import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')

Meshing: iterate all blocks, for each of 6 neighbors, if neighbor is air or transparent (water adjacent to glass etc) then add face. Need block-specific visibility rules:

Per-vertex AO: classic 0-3 based on side neighbors around each vertex. Use light = [0.45..1]. Combined with normal face shade: top 1.0, bottom 0.55, x 0.78, z 0.68. Vertex color = shade * ao. Lambert directional light would double-shade; use MeshBasicMaterial? Basic with vertexColors and fog is great, colors baked. content.text:
Vite 8? Node 22 supports. But the runtime start script supports vite by running node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build. Vite 8 might require Node 20.19+/22.12+, we have 22.23, fine. Use vite ^7 or ^8? Safer with latest 8.3.5? It's 2026, fine. But to minimize risk, use vite ^7.1.0? The script only uses vite CLI. Let's use latest (8.3.5) and verify build. Now code. Let me create project files. Constants: CHUNK_SIZE 16, WORLD_HEIGHT 80, SEA_LEVEL 26. Noise implementation: - hash2(x,z,seed) returns 0..1 - valueNoise2(x,z,seed) with smoothstep interpolation - fbm2(x,z,seed,octaves,lacunarity,gain) - valueNoise3 for caves. Use separate seed offsets. Terrain: For each column: const nx = wx * 0.006, nz = wz * 0.006 continent = fbm2(nx, nz, seed+1, 4, 2, 0.5) // 0..1 hills = fbm2(wx*0.02, wz*0.02, seed+2, 4, 2, 0.5) ridge = 1 - Math.abs(fbm2(wx*0.0055, wz*0.0055, seed+3, 4,2,.5)*2-1); ridge = ridge^2 height = 22 + continent*18 + hills*8 + ridge*ridge*30*max(0,continent-0.45) Maybe too mountainous. Target ~26-50 with water in low areas. Sea level 26. Let's define: base = 20 + fbm2(wx*0.0045, wz*0.0045, seed+11, 4)*22 → 20..42; around 31 avg. hills = (fbm2(wx*0.02, wz*0.02, seed+12, 3)-0.5)*8 mountain mask = smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, fbm2(wx*0.003,wz*0.003,seed+13,2)) mountain = ridge(...)*28*mask height = floor(base + hills + mountain) → 26..75, clamp 4..WORLD_HEIGHT-8. Sea level 26 → low base areas underwater (20 + noise*22 avg 31, 20% underwater?). Good bays. Biome: temperature = fbm2(wx*0.003+..., ...) adjust latitude? Use noise. If temp < 0.32 → snow; if < 0.42 and moisture low → desert? Let's use: temp = fbm2(wx*0.0025, wz*0.0025, seed+21, 3) moist = fbm2(wx*0.003, wz*0.003, seed+22, 3) if height > 48 → snow cap if height > 52 biome: temp < 0.38 → snowy; temp > 0.62 && moist < 0.45 → desert; else plains/forest (moist > 0.55 dense trees). Surface: if h <= sea+1 and h < sea: sand near shore (h >= sea-2) else dirt/stone? underwater floor sand if h>sea-4 else gravel. top block: snow if snowy & h>sea+2 else grass; sand if desert; if h <= sea then sand/gravel. sub surface dirt 3 blocks (sand 3 in desert). stone below. bedrock at y=0..1. water fill from h+1 to sea. Snow layer? Snow block. Trees: For each column in chunk margin 2, deterministic hash. Tree if biome forest/plains and top is grass and h>sea+1 and hash < density (forest .02, plains .004) and no adjacent? Tree spacing: use local hash; could overlap, acceptable but maybe messy. To make nice, use grid cells 5x5 with jitter and hash; tree positions computed per cell, ensures spacing. For each cell (cx*5..), tree at cell origin + hash*3 offset. For each tree within margin of chunk, stamp trunk height 4-6 and leaf blob. Need check terrain height at tree pos globally via heightAt(wx,wz) function (noise-based) and surface block, cheap. Stamp into this chunk if coordinates inside. Also desert cactus: 1x1, trunk 2-4 with no leaves, in desert cells. Leaves blob: standard: layers dy 3..5 radius 2 for lower, radius 1 top; ensure don't overwrite trunk. Use tree hash per cell for presence (~40% forest, 12% plains) and type. Trees in snow biome: spruce-ish (taller, conical) maybe. Keep simple: same oak with snow? Use dark leaves? Fine. Flowers/grass tufts: nice detail. Add plant blocks (id 16 tall grass, 17 flower) as cross-quads? That complicates meshing. Could add as small crossed quads in mesh, non-solid, breakable. Visual richness. Let's implement a separate "decor" geometry per chunk: for grass blocks, hash chance 0.08 → add 2 crossed quads with grass tuft texture. Also flowers 0.01 with red/yellow texture. This makes terrain look alive. Use alphaTest material with atlas tiles for tuft and flower. Cross quads: 4 vertices each, positioned randomly in block, ~0.6 height. It's extra geometry but fine. Need tile textures 18 grass_tuft (transparent), 19 flower_red, 20 flower_yellow. Add these as block IDs? For raycast, they shouldn't block. Keep as decorative generated at mesh time based on hash; not stored (unless broken? unbreakable visual detail, fine; but if block removed the decor disappears on remesh). Simplify: decor built during meshing from top grass blocks with deterministic hash. Store none. When block removed, remesh, decor gone. Meshing details: - For each block: - if water: handle water faces (only if neighbor air or glass? top and sides against air). Also water should render top at sea level. transparent mesh. - if air/plant skip. - if leaves/glass: draw faces where neighbor is air or water. For glass, also draw against leaves? okay. - opaque: draw face where neighbor is not opaque (air, water, leaves, glass). Wait if neighbor is glass and our stone face should be visible through glass → yes draw. If neighbor is leaves, draw. If neighbor water, draw. Good. - Face vertex positions with per-face corner ordering and UVs. - AO: for each face vertex, sample 3 neighbors (side1, side2, corner) in the plane in front of the face. Compute occlusion from opaque blocks only. Standard: ao = 3 - (side1?1:0) - (side2?1:0) - (corner?1:0)? Then map [0..3] → [0.45, 0.65, 0.82, 1.0]. Flip quad triangulation if a00+a11 > a01+a10 to avoid anisotropy. - Face shading factors: top 1.0, bottom 0.5, north/south 0.8, east/west 0.7. - Vertex color = shade * ao (RGB same). Store as float 0..1. - UV: tile index → u0 = (col + 0.0005)/8? Use half-pixel inset: (col*16 + 0.5)/128. With NearestFilter, sampling near edge could still fetch neighbor when minified without mipmaps; inset 0.5 texel good. - Positions relative to chunk origin? Use world coordinates in geometry and mesh at origin; simpler for raycast/collisions. Chunk mesh position (cx*16, 0, cz*16) with local coords. Fine. To avoid seams, use per-chunk local coords and mesh position. Good. Index count: use Uint32? Vertex count per chunk could exceed 65535 (leaves etc). Use Uint32Array indices always (WebGL2 fine). Or 65535 likely enough for 16x16x80? Worst-case 3k faces*4=12k verts, fine, but use Uint32 for safety. Chunk mesh creation: build arrays then BufferGeometry set attributes. Compute normals explicitly as attribute. Shared materials: - opaqueMat = MeshBasicMaterial({ map: atlas, vertexColors: true, alphaTest: 0.5? No—opaque blocks don't need alpha; but leaves/glass use cutoutMat. Use separate solidMat with no alphaTest, cutoutMat with alphaTest 0.4 and side: DoubleSide? Leaves quads are cube faces; DoubleSide not needed (back faces hidden by culling normally, but from inside leaves you'd see through). Set side: DoubleSide for cutout adds cost. Use FrontSide. Glass frame fine. - waterMat transparent opacity 0.72, depthWrite false, side: DoubleSide? FrontSide (top faces visible from above; from underwater you'd see backface missing → water invisible from below, acceptable but weird). Use DoubleSide for water only. - MeshBasicMaterial supports fog. Separate geometry per material: solid (opaque + cutout?) Cutout needs alphaTest; combining leaves into solid material with alphaTest 0.5 affects all opaque textures? Their alpha=1 so fine! Use one material with alphaTest 0.5 for all opaque blocks. Yes, all atlas textures opaque alpha=1 except leaves/glass/tufts. So one mesh per chunk for solid+cutout (alphaTest), plus one transparent mesh for water. Decor tufts/flowers also alphaTest 0.5 → in solid mesh. But water needs transparent blending → second mesh. Draw order: three.js sorts transparent objects; water mesh per chunk. Fine. Atlas tiles: draw with noise. Implementation details per tile: Helper `tile(ctx, index, baseColor, fn)`. - Use 16x16, each pixel with hash noise variations ±8%. - grass_top: green base #5fa83c with darker/lighter speckles, maybe some yellow-green. - grass_side: bottom 11 rows dirt, top 5 rows green with jagged edge (per-column random depth). Add darker green at edge. - dirt: brown #8a5a35 with darker specks, occasional pebble. - stone: gray #8b8f94 vary, add a few darker cracks. - cobblestone: gray rounded stones with dark mortar: draw random blobs—simpler per-pixel pattern using hash at cell level. Could generate with 8x8 stone cells and mortar border. Draw manually 4 stones. - sand: #e6d29a with speckles. - snow: #f2f7fa with light blue specks. - log_side: brown vertical bark stripes, dark grooves. - log_top: rings concentric circles on tan. - leaves: transparent base with clusters of green pixels, holes ~15%. - planks: horizontal planks with dark seams every 5 px and vertical joints. - water: blue with lighter wavy lines; alpha ~0.8. - glass: mostly transparent center with light blue tint border pixels alpha 0.15? With alphaTest 0.4, alpha<0.4 pixels are discarded → center hole. Border frame opaque light blue/white. Looks like glass pane outlines. Add a diagonal highlight line maybe. - bedrock: dark gray jagged. - bricks: red bricks with white mortar. - sandstone: layered tan. - gravel: mixed gray/brown pebbles. - grass tuft: transparent with green blades. - flower_red: transparent, green stem + red petals. - flower_yellow. - glow? maybe not. - snow_side? use snow tile all sides. Atlas 8x8 = 64 tiles but we have ~21. Fine, texture 128x128. // Block registry. Face order is: +X, -X, +Y (top), -Y (bottom), +Z, -Z.

export const AIR = 0
export const GRASS = 1
export const DIRT = 2
export const STONE = 3
export const COBBLE = 4
export const SAND = 5
export const SNOW = 6
export const LOG = 7
export const LEAVES = 8
export const PLANKS = 9
export const WATER = 10
export const GLASS = 11
export const BEDROCK = 12
export const BRICKS = 13
export const SANDSTONE = 14
export const GRAVEL = 15

// Tile indices inside the generated texture atlas.
export const TILES = {
  grassTop: 0,
  grassSide: 1,
  dirt: 2,
  stone: 3,
  cobble: 4,
  sand: 5,
  snow: 6,
  logSide: 7,
  logTop: 8,
  leaves: 9,
  planks: 10,
  water: 11,
  glass: 12,
  bedrock: 13,
  bricks: 14,
  sandstone: 15,
  gravel: 16,
  tuft: 17,
  flowerRed: 18,
  flowerYellow: 19
}

const def = (id, name, tiles, options = {}) => ({
  id,
  name,
  tiles,
  solid: options.solid !== false,
  opaque: options.opaque !== false,
  cutout: Boolean(options.cutout),
  liquid: Boolean(options.liquid),
  color: options.color || [0.6, 0.6, 0.6],
  ...options
})

export const BLOCKS = {
  [GRASS]: def(GRASS, 'Grass Block', { top: TILES.grassTop, side: TILES.grassSide, bottom: TILES.dirt }, {
    color: [0.42, 0.67, 0.24]
  }),
  [DIRT]: def(DIRT, 'Dirt', TILES.dirt, { color: [0.53, 0.36, 0.22] }),
  [STONE]: def(STONE, 'Stone', TILES.stone, { color: [0.56, 0.58, 0.6] }),
  [COBBLE]: def(COBBLE, 'Cobblestone', TILES.cobble, { color: [0.5, 0.52, 0.54] }),
  [SAND]: def(SAND, 'Sand', TILES.sand, { color: [0.88, 0.8, 0.58] }),
  [SNOW]: def(SNOW, 'Snow', TILES.snow, { color: [0.93, 0.96, 0.98] }),
  [LOG]: def(LOG, 'Oak Log', { top: TILES.logTop, side: TILES.logSide, bottom: TILES.logTop }, {
    color: [0.45, 0.33, 0.19]
  }),
  [LEAVES]: def(LEAVES, 'Leaves', TILES.leaves, {
    opaque: false,
    cutout: true,
    color: [0.3, 0.58, 0.19]
  }),
  [PLANKS]: def(PLANKS, 'Oak Planks', TILES.planks, { color: [0.72, 0.56, 0.32] }),
  [WATER]: def(WATER, 'Water', TILES.water, {
    solid: false,
    opaque: false,
    liquid: true,
    color: [0.25, 0.47, 0.78]
  }),
  [GLASS]: def(GLASS, 'Glass', TILES.glass, {
    opaque: false,
    cutout: true,
    color: [0.72, 0.86, 0.92]
  }),
  [BEDROCK]: def(BEDROCK, 'Bedrock', TILES.bedrock, { color: [0.2, 0.2, 0.22] }),
  [BRICKS]: def(BRICKS, 'Bricks', TILES.bricks, { color: [0.6, 0.27, 0.2] }),
  [SANDSTONE]: def(SANDSTONE, 'Sandstone', TILES.sandstone, { color: [0.84, 0.76, 0.55] }),
  [GRAVEL]: def(GRAVEL, 'Gravel', TILES.gravel, { color: [0.52, 0.49, 0.47] })
}

export const HOTBAR = [GRASS, DIRT, STONE, COBBLE, SAND, LOG, PLANKS, LEAVES, GLASS]

export function tileFor(block, face) {
  if (face === 2) return block.tiles.top ?? block.tiles.all ?? block.tiles
  if (face === 3) return block.tiles.bottom ?? block.tiles.all ?? block.tiles
  return block.tiles.side ?? block.tiles.all ?? block.tiles
}

export function isOpaque(id) {
  return id !== AIR && BLOCKS[id]?.opaque === true
}

export function isSolid(id) {
  return id !== AIR && BLOCKS[id]?.solid !== false
}

export function isLiquid(id) {
  return BLOCKS[id]?.liquid === true
}

function createIcon(blockId) {
    const size = 64
    const block = BLOCKS[blockId]
    const icon = document.createElement('canvas')
    icon.width = size
    icon.height = size
    const ictx = icon.getContext('2d')
    ictx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false

    const topTile = tileFor(block, 2)
    const sideTile = tileFor(block, 0)
    const topX = (topTile % COLS) * TILE_SIZE
    const topY = Math.floor(topTile / COLS) * TILE_SIZE
    const sideX = (sideTile % COLS) * TILE_SIZE
    const sideY = Math.floor(sideTile / COLS) * TILE_SIZE

    const drawFace = (sx, sy, transform, shade) => {
      ictx.save()
      ictx.setTransform(...transform)
      if (blockId === GLASS) {
        ictx.fillStyle = 'rgba(196, 232, 244, 0.3)'
        ictx.fillRect(0, 0, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
      }
      ictx.drawImage(canvas, sx, sy, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE, 0, 0, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
      if (shade > 0) {
        ictx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop'
        ictx.fillStyle = `rgba(8, 14, 22, ${shade})`
        ictx.fillRect(0, 0, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
      }
      ictx.restore()
    }

    // Isometric cube: top diamond, left face, right face.
    drawFace(topX, topY, [1.625, 0.875, -1.625, 0.875, 32, 6], 0)
    drawFace(sideX, sideY, [1.625, 0.875, 0, 1.625, 6, 20], 0.16)
    drawFace(sideX, sideY, [1.625, -0.875, 0, 1.625, 32, 34], 0.3)

    ictx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(5, 10, 16, 0.42)'
    ictx.lineWidth = 1
    ictx.beginPath()
    ictx.moveTo(32, 6)
    ictx.lineTo(58, 20)
    ictx.lineTo(32, 34)
    ictx.lineTo(6, 20)
    ictx.closePath()
    ictx.moveTo(6, 20)
    ictx.lineTo(6, 46)
    ictx.lineTo(32, 60)
    ictx.lineTo(32, 34)
    ictx.lineTo(58, 20)
    ictx.lineTo(58, 46)
    ictx.lineTo(32, 60)
    ictx.stroke()

    return icon
  }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable Minecraft-like browser game from scratch in the existing repo, with a polished 3D voxel world, controls, and responsive/mobile support, then verify it visually.

## Requirements
- User request: "Create a game like minecraft"
- Must run via existing static/Vite deployment flow on port 3002.
- Support desktop and mobile/touch controls with safe-area-aware UI.
- Capture pipeline auto-clicks a visible button labeled exactly `Play`; world must be ready within its 3s window and render gameplay ~1s after click.

## Decisions
- Use Vite 8.3.5 + three.js 0.187.0, all textures/audio procedurally generated (no external assets).
- Chunked procedural world (`16×80×16` chunks), infinite streaming, per-face culling, baked AO/shade, generated texture atlas.
- Creative sandbox: break/place blocks, hotbar, flying toggle, day/night cycle, clouds, water, save/load to localStorage.
- Curated default seed `17708808` for a scenic lake spawn; `New World` uses a random seed via `?seed=`.
- Isometric hotbar icons generated from atlas tiles for a Minecraft feel.
- Current spawn clearing removes trees within radius 5 and 10 blocks high to guarantee an open first view.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffold: Vite config, package.json, HTML/CSS UI, game modules.
- Worldgen: biomes, terrain, water, trees (oak/spruce), sandstone rocks, spawn scoring, seeded noise.
- Rendering: chunk meshing, AO, texture atlas, sky shader with stars/sun/moon, clouds, fog, day/night tint.
- Player physics/collision, walking/sprinting/jumping/swimming/flying, pointer-lock + drag fallback, touch joystick/look/buttons.
- Block interaction: DDA raycast, highlight, break/place, particles, sounds, bedrock protection.
- HUD/menu/loading/pause screens, hotbar, stats, clock, underwater overlay.
- Save/load (`voxelcraft.save.v1`), URL seed override now ignores save data entirely.
- Production build succeeds (`npm run build`), dev server runs in tmux session `voxel`.
- Manual Playwright verification: break/place/fly work; desktop and mobile screenshots captured; pointer lock succeeds.
- Reduced fog haze (`FOG_NEAR=46`, `FOG_FAR=74`), improved leaves texture, sun now normal-blended with visible square core.
- Island/coast spawn screenshots evaluated; seed `17708808` selected as best default vista.
- Added `window.__VOXEL__` debug handle exposing `world/player/sky/breakTarget/placeTarget/select/target`.

### Active
- Just changed hotbar icons to isometric cubes, set default seed, and made spawn prefer plains/snow; these edits have not been re-tested or re-screenshotted.
- Need to verify touch hotbar reposition (moved to `bottom: 150px`) does not overlap controls.
- Need to set/verify final mobile portrait pitch (`-0.17` on new worlds) and hotbar layout.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Restart/reload dev server page, clear localStorage, screenshot menu and gameplay at 1440×900 with default seed `17708808`; inspect isometric hotbar icons and scene.
2. Verify mobile 390×844: no hotbar/joystick/button overlap, touch controls visible, portrait view shows enough terrain.
3. Test pause (Esc), resume, New World reload, night sky (`sky.time=0.9`), and underwater overlay.
4. Re-run `npm run build`; fix any regressions.
5. Clean test artifacts: remove `screenshots/*.png` if unwanted (gitignored) and clear localStorage test saves; confirm no console errors.
6. Commit/push final changes if expected by workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: orchestration, UI, input, save/load, game loop, debug handle.
- `src/world.js`: chunk streaming, meshing/AO, materials, raycast, edits; exports `RENDER_DISTANCE`, `FOG_NEAR`, `FOG_FAR`.
- `src/worldgen.js`: terrain/biomes/trees/spawn scoring; constants `CHUNK_SIZE=16`, `WORLD_HEIGHT=80`, `SEA_LEVEL=26`.
- `src/textures.js`: procedural atlas and new isometric `createIcon`.
- `src/blocks.js`: block registry, `HOTBAR`, tile lookup.
- `src/player.js`: movement, collision, fly/swim, camera.
- `src/sky.js`: sky shader, sun/moon, clouds, day/night colors/fog.
- `src/styles.css`: HUD/menu/mobile layout; touch hotbar at `bottom: 150px`.
- `src/noise.js`: seeded hash/value noise/FBM.
- `src/particles.js`: break particles.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized WebAudio effects.
- `index.html`: menus/HUD/touch markup; Play button text must remain `Play`.
- `package.json`, `vite.config.js`: build config/dependencies.

## Important Context
- Dev server: tmux session `voxel`, URL `http://localhost:3002`, currently running `npm run dev`.
- Playwright CLI requires `DISPLAY=:0`; browser installed manually via `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
- Capture auto-start regex only matches exact `Play`/`Start Game`/`Play Now`; menu must be visible with enabled Play button.
- World preload ready time measured ~1.8–1.9s at initial radius 4; capture deadline is 3s.
- SwiftShader rendering ~20fps at 1440×900; no JS errors, only WebGL performance warnings.
- URL `?seed=` intentionally discards saved player/edits/time; plain reload resumes local save.
- Fixed default spawn height range is `SEA_LEVEL+2..SEA_LEVEL+11`; most natural spawns are y≈28–37.
- Screenshots exist in `screenshots/` (`menu3.png`, `play4.png`, `seed-17708808.png`, `seed-4260058432.png`, etc.) and are gitignored.
- Test debug pattern: set `window.__VOXEL__.player.pitch=-1.2`, wait a frame, call `breakTarget()` / `placeTarget()`.
- Current changes are uncommitted; repo HEAD is `af821a3 Install OpenCode issue listener`.

  update(dt, cameraPosition) {
    this.time += dt / this.cycleSeconds
    if (this.time >= 1) {
      this.time -= 1
      this.day++
    }

    const angle = (this.time - 0.25) * Math.PI * 2
    const elevation = Math.sin(angle)
    this.sunDirection.set(Math.cos(angle), elevation, 0.3).normalize()
    this.daylight = smoothstep(-0.1, 0.14, elevation)
    this.twilight = Math.exp(-Math.pow(elevation / 0.16, 2))
    this.night = 1 - smoothstep(-0.12, 0.05, elevation)

    const dayTop = CACHE.dayTop
    const dayHorizon = CACHE.dayHorizon
    const nightTop = CACHE.nightTop
    const nightHorizon = CACHE.nightHorizon
    const duskTop = CACHE.duskTop
    const duskHorizon = CACHE.duskHorizon

    CACHE.top.copy(nightTop).lerp(dayTop, this.daylight)
    CACHE.top.lerp(duskTop, this.twilight * 0.55 * (0.35 + this.daylight * 0.65))
    CACHE.horizon.copy(nightHorizon).lerp(dayHorizon, this.daylight)
    CACHE.horizon.lerp(duskHorizon, this.twilight * 0.9)

    this.uniforms.uZenith.value.copy(CACHE.top)
    this.uniforms.uHorizon.value.copy(CACHE.horizon)
    this.uniforms.uGround.value.copy(CACHE.horizon).multiplyScalar(0.62)
    this.uniforms.uSunDir.value.copy(this.sunDirection)
    this.uniforms.uNight.value = this.night
    this.uniforms.uSunColor.value.setRGB(
      1.0,
      0.82 + this.daylight * 0.12,
      0.62 + this.daylight * 0.3
    )

    this.fogColor.copy(CACHE.horizon)
    this.horizonColor.copy(CACHE.horizon)
    this.scene.fog.color.copy(this.horizonColor)

    const warm = this.twilight * 0.16 * (0.4 + this.daylight * 0.6)
    this.blockTint.setRGB(
      0.3 + 0.7 * this.daylight + warm,
      0.37 + 0.63 * this.daylight + warm * 0.55,
      0.58 + 0.42 * this.daylight
    )
    this.waterTint.copy(this.blockTint)

    this.cloudMaterial.color.setRGB(
      0.45 + 0.55 * this.daylight + warm,
      0.52 + 0.48 * this.daylight + warm * 0.5,
      0.72 + 0.28 * this.daylight
    )
    this.cloudMaterial.opacity = 0.28 + 0.48 * this.daylight

    if (cameraPosition) {
      this.sphere.position.copy(cameraPosition)
      this.sunSprite.position
        .copy(cameraPosition)
        .addScaledVector(this.sunDirection, 340)
      this.moonSprite.position
        .copy(cameraPosition)
        .addScaledVector(this.sunDirection, -340)
      this.sunSprite.visible = this.sunDirection.y > -0.12
      this.moonSprite.visible = this.sunDirection.y < 0.12
      this.cloudDrift += dt * 1.8
      this._writeCloudMatrices(cameraPosition.x, cameraPosition.z)
    }
  }

  get clockLabel() {
    const totalMinutes = Math.floor(this.time * 24 * 60)
    const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60)
    const minutes = totalMinutes % 60
    return `Day ${this.day} · ${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}`
  }
}
